step.title: pfBlockerNG Components
step.description:
CAUTION BEFORE PROCEEDING!
  • The pfBlockerNG wizard will configure a default setup for pfBlockerNG.
  • This default configuration is a basic setup for new installations.
  • Warning: If you have previously configured pfBlockerNG, this wizard replaces your lists and settings and clears downloaded feeds. Scheduled Feed Updates, the Default Schedule and the Download Failure Threshold are kept.
  • Two components will be installed:
IP:
Adds outbound reject rules for the PRI1 feeds on the selected Outbound interfaces.
DNSBL:
DNSBL blocks domains from the configured feeds through the DNS Resolver.
  • A VIP on the Localhost interface can be configured manually at Firewall > Virtual IPs, or set Auto VIP in the DNSBL step. The DNSBL WebServer/VIP response is deprecated: the VIP is only needed while a DNSBL block answers with it.

step.title: DNSBL settings
step.description:
Configure the DNSBL settings. The DNSBL WebServer/VIP response is deprecated: a Virtual IP is only needed while a DNSBL block answers with it. Enable Auto VIP below to have pfBlockerNG manage the DNSBL sinkhole Virtual IP, or configure a VIP on the Localhost interface manually first at Firewall > Virtual IPs.
Optional: the ports below are used only if you later switch a DNSBL group to the deprecated WebServer/VIP mode and set Web Server Interface to something other than Localhost.

field.name: pfb_dnsvip_auto
field.description:
Auto VIP: when enabled, pfBlockerNG manages the DNSBL sinkhole Virtual IP itself, but only while a DNSBL block answers with it. The wizard's DNSBL group uses Null Blocking, so no VIP is created now; the DNSBL page shows the address it would use. The manual selections below are ignored while Auto VIP is on.
HA: with pfBlockerNG Sync set to Policy and lists (local settings stay local), a secondary that also uses Auto VIP creates its VIP at the address the primary chose. If that address is in use on the secondary, no VIP is created and the Sync page reports the conflict.

field.name: pfb_dnsvip4
field.description: Select the IPv4 DNSBL Virtual IP (manual mode only — ignored when Auto VIP is enabled)

field.name: pfb_dnsvip6
field.description: Select the IPv6 DNSBL Virtual IP (manual mode only — ignored when Auto VIP is enabled)

field.name: pfb_dnsport
field.description: HTTP port for the DNSBL block page (default 8081).

field.name: pfb_dnsport_ssl
field.description: HTTPS port for the DNSBL block page (default 8443).

field.name: suppression
field.description: Enable the default DNSBL Whitelist. You can change or remove it after the wizard finishes.

All configuration parameters have been successfully collected.

Warning: Finishing this wizard replaces your pfBlockerNG lists and settings and clears downloaded feeds. Scheduled Feed Updates, the Default Schedule and the Download Failure Threshold are kept.

To save this default configuration and apply these changes, press the Finish button.
